text:
nina_ops: Getting user reports of a lot of tiny-GPU jobs Pending in us-central1 after the maintenance window. Looks like many nodes at 50% GPU but scheduler won't place new 0.125 GPU containers on them.

omar_sched: Same alert here. Pod events show two blockers: a `rack:isolation=restricted:NoSchedule` taint and "Insufficient memory" even though memory looks fine on the nodes.

kai_infra: We bumped kubelet reserved memory per GPU to 3Gi last week, that could create phantom Insufficient memory for tiny pods. Also the new rack isolation taint was applied to prevent cross-rack NVLink sharing.

taylor_qa: Repro in staging: create 100 pods with limits: gpu=0.125, mem=1Gi -> many stay Pending while nodes show free GPU and mem.

omar_sched: Scheduler scoring currently punishes fragmentation heavily; it prefers nodes with no GPUs allocated to avoid co-tenancy. That explains why half-filled nodes remain underused.

nina_ops: Quick mitigation options? We have users timing out.

kai_infra: Two low-risk steps: 1) temporarily reduce kubelet GPU reservation from 3Gi->1Gi on warmpool nodes, 2) add a short-lived mutating webhook that adds toleration for `rack:isolation:NoSchedule` for pods annotated `redwood/small-gpu=true`.

omar_sched: I can also flip a scheduler feature flag to enable "fractional-packing" scoring in staging which prefers filling existing GPU-bearing nodes. That needs canary but could be quick.

taylor_qa: Runbook note: any mutating webhook change needs a security thumbs-up. Also test preemption interaction.

pager-bot: Incident INC-2026-41 created: tiny-gpu-pending-us-central. Assigned to eng-platform.

kai_infra: I'll roll kubelet reservation to canary AZ now.

omar_sched: I'll enable fractional-packing in staging and run the 200 tiny-pod smoke test.

taylor_qa: Staging fractional-packing looked promising: Pending dropped from 67 -> 8 in the test cluster. No OOMs on model load.

kai_infra: Canary reservation change complete. Observed Pending drop of ~70% in canary AZ. Rolling to rest of region in 10m.

omar_sched: Putting webhook manifest in a PR for review. It only adds toleration when `redwood/small-gpu=true` is present.

taylor_qa: Add an alert metric: count(pods_pending{reason=FailedScheduling, taint=~"rack:isolation"}) / count(small_gpu_pods) > 0.15 per region.

nina_ops: Thanks folks. After rollouts, follow-ups: permanent fractional-packing config, adjust reservation policy by GPU size, and a telemetry dashboard for small-pod packing. Closing once tracked. :thumbsup:
